_note: How many indicator LEDs each serial channel lights on the LED board; read by `python -m tmaze.tools.sync_fit --map` to know how many to look for (see tmaze/core/sync/board_layout.py, docs/decisions/0196). Each beam (S0-S5) and lick (L0-L2) sensor lights two LEDs, one per row (named _a = bright row, _b = dim row); each reward valve (SOL..) one. leds_per_channel (e.g. "S0": 1) overrides leds_per_kind for a single channel. exclusive_groups: channels of which at most one can be active at a time (one rat cannot break two beams or lick two ports at once); every sync_fit run keeps only the strongest channel of a group active per frame, so LED light spilling from one channel's LEDs into its neighbours' is not read as a second event (docs/decisions/0201). Remove a group (or pass --no-one-active) when that stops being true, e.g. two animals in the rig.
